Facts about lighthouses:
1. The word "lighthouse" is derived from the ancient Greek name for the Pharos island, where the Pharos of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, was located.
2. Modern lighthouses often use LED lights and solar power to reduce maintenance costs and environmental impact, replacing older incandescent bulbs and fuel sources.
3. Lighthouses serve not only as navigational aids for maritime traffic but also as historical landmarks and tourist attractions in many coastal regions.
